1  ORDER

The petitioner herein seeks a direction to respondents to consider his representation dated 19.08.2024 seeking correction in the award passed by the 1st respondent dated 20.06.2024.
2.

It is the case of the petitioner that he is the owner of 1352 Sq.feet of land situated in Survey.No.158/2A4 at Kallakurichi Village, Kallakurichi Taluk and Kallakurichi District and the entire extent in the said survey number was acquired by the respondents for forming a new railway line.
The 2nd respondent, at the time of passing award, calculated the compensation for a lesser extent of 1 ares by taking into considering the patta issued in the name of petitioner.

The learned counsel for the petitioner, by taking this Court to the linear measurement found in the FMB issued to the above mentioned property, submits that the petitioner is entitled to 1352 Sq.feet of land in the above https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis mentioned survey number.
The 2nd respondent passed award only for a lesser extent.
In order to correct the extent mentioned in the award, the petitioner submitted a representation before the respondent on 19.08.2024 and the same has not been considered.
Hence, he is before this Court.

3. The learned Government Advocate, who is taking notice for the respondents 1 and 2, submits that the representation of the petitioner will be considered on its' own merits within a time fixed by this Court.

4. In view of the same, without going into the merits of the claim made by the petitioner, this Court is inclined to issue direction to the 1st respondent to consider the representation of the petitioner dated 19.08.2024 and pass final orders in the light of Section 33 of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 within a period of six weeks from the date of receipt of copy of this order.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 5.
